what: lower_body (expr_store/lower.rs ~123) honours #[rust_analyzer::skip]: it lowers a written body to a Missing root with missing params. rustc ignores that tool attribute and compiles and checks the body, so this drops a body rustc builds (superset-of-rust). Lower the body regardless of the attribute. Until then hir-ty-borrowck check_def refuses such a body (skipped, Unsupported) rather than passing it: see hir-ty-borrowck missing_body_tests.rs a_written_body_lowered_to_nothing_is_refused, which flips to a_body_is_checked once fixed.
